winning_patterns.pattern: Broad family & universal relationship emotional dynamics
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about parents, siblings, and spouses (e.g., 'or5gtaBpRVY' with 1478 views, 'rl_ycNbXZ_g' with 288 views) vastly outperform niche heartbreak/self-respect text statuses.

winning_patterns.action: Use titles that prompt a subtle behavioral shift or an empathetic realization in the viewer.

weak_patterns.action: Avoid overusing digital breakup tropes (chat pinning, blue ticks, blocking) as they have saturated the niche and show low audience retention.
